blind.description: A stylized potted palm plant. At the base is a rounded dark green glazed pot with a golden-yellow segmented rim, filled with brown soil. A textured, segmented warm orange-brown palm trunk rises vertically, topped by a crown of vibrant green arched palm fronds with notched leaf edges. The geometry is clean, solid, and continuous with stylized video game proportions and smooth cartoon shading.
blind.from_above: A radial starburst of broad, notched green palm fronds arching outward from the central trunk, partially exposing the golden rim of the pot beneath.
blind.height_vs_figure: Roughly 3/4 the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 4.2 feet tall), with a foliage crown spread about 4 feet wide.

notes: crown spread is wider relative to height than catalog ratio, but reads naturally as a palm with arching fronds
